info.title: Admin Unit Details API Reference
info.description: Get detailed information about a specific administrative unit identified by its country code and admin unit code. Returns the unit name, admin code, ISO 3166-2 code, admin level type, country ISO code, and country name. Both the `country` and `admin_unit` parameters are required; invalid or unmatched combinations return a 400 or 404 error respectively.

get.summary: Retrieve detailed information about a specific administrative unit
get.description: Returns comprehensive details for a single administrative unit identified by country code and admin code.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format (e.g., US, PK).

parameters.name: admin_unit
parameters.description: Admin code of the administrative unit being requested.

200.description: Successful response with admin unit details

typicalSuccess.summary: Unit with a real ISO 3166-2 subdivision code

noIso3166_2.summary: Unit with no real ISO 3166-2 code (e.g. US military postal regions) — admin_iso3166_2 is absent

400.description: Bad Request — Missing country/admin_unit parameter, invalid country code, or invalid admin code

MissingParams.summary: Missing required country or admin_unit parameter

value.message: Only ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes country codes are supported.

InvalidAdminCode.summary: admin_unit code does not exist for the given country

value.message: Please provide a valid admin code.

404.description: Not Found — Country is a recognized ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code but has no published admin units (e.g. Vatican City)

NoAdminUnits.summary: No admin units for this country

value.error: No Admin Unit present in country
value.message: This Country does not have any admin units associated with it.

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

AdminUnitDetailsResponse.description: Detailed information for a single administrative unit resolved from a country code and admin unit code.

admin_iso3166_2.description: The unit's full ISO 3166-2 code, formed as {country}-{admin_code} (e.g., US-CA, PK-BA, TV-FUN).

admin_level.description: Level or type of the administrative unit (e.g., province, region, state).

country_iso3166_2.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by the API on failed requests.

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.

X-AF-Credits-Cost.description: Specifies the number of credits consumed by the current request.
